_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: deciding what to make or test next — campaign concepts, angles, hooks, a creative brief, the test plan — and running the whole campaign end to end (the plan gates the build). Should-not-trigger: researching competitors (researching-competitor-ads), auditing own ads (analyzing-own-ads), brand identity (analyzing-brand), product facts (analyzing-products), a single ad with no plan behind it (the producer skills), writing the platform copy fields (writing-ad-copy), and an off-topic control.
